retailers.note: Swept 2026-10-24 via the itxrest API over 20 women's category ids (the VIEW ALL id of every women's section plus Blazers, Suits, Studio, Lingerie, Puffer jackets, New in, Evening; ids in cursor.categories). 1,818 product ids, 1,329 unique product URLs, 1,255 not yet in the ledger. 484 passed the fiber rule; 329 staged in round 2026-10-24-nightly before the 450 photo limit, 155 passing pieces held and not recorded (the next run re-reads the API and stages them; they sort after Jackets, Sweaters, Trousers, Dresses, Skirts, Coats, Leather, T-shirts, Cashmere and Shirts). 658 recorded under fiber, 27 accessories and shoes out of scope. Not recorded on purpose, so they come back: 28 whose composition did not parse cleanly (wool-blend coats with other fibres, furskin), 54 clothing pieces the scope filter wrongly flagged (cape, scarf detail, belt, capri in the name), 4 Total look bundles, 35 ids the productsArray call did not return. Family names carry a stray A-circumflex before non-breaking spaces; normalise before matching. Colour 'Washed' has no swatch; 2 knits held for a photo-based colour. 2026-10-24 evening: re-read all 20 categories (1,805 ids). Staged the 130 passing pieces not yet in the ledger (the held set, minus pieces since sold out). 61 fiber, 9 out-of-scope, 3 rejected (argyle sweaters and hooded knits). Not recorded, so they come back: 12 'Look' or unnamed bundle entries, 4 with no family, 35 ids the productsArray call did not return. Image deliveryPath can carry its own ?ts= query; strip it before adding ?w=600.
Full products.json sweep, 220 staged. Skipped Menswear, Hats & Gloves, Scarves, Travel Wraps.
Full sweep 2026-10-23. 1,750 products read. 359 staged (nightly3), 115 under the fiber rule, sold-out pieces not recorded so a delta run picks up restocks.

Full sweep 2026-10-23. 520 products read. 85 staged (nightly4). 240 clothing pieces list no composition on the site, so they are recorded as no-composition for a delta run to recheck. Polyester and regenerated leather pieces recorded under fiber.

Full sweep 2026-10-23. 397 products read. 294 staged (nightly5). 9 denim pieces under the fiber rule (cotton lyocell). 5 felted pieces list only "cashmere wool blend", recorded as no-composition. Accessories out of scope. Pieces tagged for him or unisex only skipped. Sold-out pieces not recorded so a delta run picks up restocks.

Full sweep 2026-10-23 from naadam.co (naadam.com is parked). 458 products read, 160 staged (nightly6). products.json omits composition for about a third of women's pieces; it was read from each product page instead. 55 rejected under the words and graphics rule (university, NFL, Super Bowl, Wicked, GOAT, Ski, Apres, Tennis sweaters). 139 men's, 42 out of scope, 16 under the fiber rule (modal blends), 32 with unreadable or partial composition. Mixed media pieces show their second fabric as 'Contrast fabric'. 6 passing pieces were sold out and are not recorded.

Full sweep 2026-10-23. 635 products read, 118 staged (nightly7). products.json leaves out the underlayer on most Looker and layered pieces; the product page Materials section names it (usually polyester georgette or 65/35 poly-cotton shirting), so every candidate was checked against its page. Lookers with a polyester underlayer recorded as fiber; layered pieces whose underlayer is undisclosed, and lace trims of unknown fiber, as no-composition. 369 under the fiber rule (Lookers, poly blends), 99 out of scope (accessories, shoes, jewelry, wraps). 6 passing pieces were sold out and are not recorded. Pieces are per colour, so each colourway is its own card.
Sweep int.st-agni.com, the USD store. www.st-agni.com serves AUD. 244 staged in round 2026-10-23-nightly8. Lining fiber does not count against the shell rule.

Sea lists every part of a garment (self, lining, combo, lace, embroidery). Self and every fabric part must pass the fiber rule; any lining is shown as listed. Synthetic embroidery, decoration or bead thread is allowed and shown as a trim note (Natalie, 2026-10-23). 132 staged in round 2026-10-23-nightly9.

Composition sits in a "Composition:" bullet, sometimes split into Main and Combo or with a lining named inline ("100% silk, 100% polyester lining"). Colour is the last word of the URL in Ulla's own names (noir, tigris, cognac, lichen). Chrome blocks downloads from ullajohnson.com after the first try, so pull from a neutral page such as example.com (products.json allows cross-origin reads). 400 staged in round 2026-10-23-nightly10.

Added 2026-10-23. US site intimissimi.com/us, USD. Women only (IUMAN is men's). Shortlist from the fabric listings: women/pajamas/silk, women/fabrics/silk, women/fabrics/cotton, women/fabrics/ultralight_cotton, women/fabrics/linen, women/knitwear/silk, women/knitwear/100_cashmere, women/knitwear/wool_and_silk, women/knitwear/cotton, women/knitwear/linen. Skip modal, microfibre, bamboo and lame listings. The silk listings include viscose satin and silk with polyamide lace, so read every composition: it is in the product page HTML under 'Composition and care' and fetches fine. Listings load more as you scroll (71 silk sleepwear results, 25 in the first render).

Added 2026-10-23 for Sleep and lounge. oliviavonhalle.com. Nearly all silk, some cashmere. UK brand: confirm the US price in USD on the product page (Shopify base currency may be GBP). Shopify products.json at oliviavonhalle.com/en-us/products.json gives USD prices (the root store is GBP). Composition is a 'Material:' line in body_html, trims on a 'Trims:' line. Each print is its own product; stage one card per style (first name plus garment plus fabric, e.g. Lila Pajamas in Silk Satin) and record other prints as duplicate. Mini and kids pieces, eye masks, scarves, socks, slippers and blankets are out-of-scope; Type:Mens tags are not-womens. Undisclosed colored piping gets a 'Piping, fiber not stated' trim note. Fringe can be rayon, so undisclosed fringe is no-composition. Gia Tracksuit is hooded, rejected under the hoodie rule. 2026-10-24: 272 in stock, 65 styles staged, 110 duplicate prints, 71 out-of-scope, 12 not-womens, 7 fiber, 5 rejected, 2 no-composition.

Added 2026-10-23 for Sleep and lounge. pourlesfemmes.com. Cotton, linen and silk sleep and lounge. No modal or polyester seen in the first 200 products. Shopify products.json at pourlesfemmes.com, USD. The percentage is usually on the product page under 'Fabric', not in body_html, so read the page. Colourways are separate products titled 'Style - Colour'; one card per style, others recorded as duplicate. Men's sets are not-womens; mats, bags, socks, slippers, gift boxes and the washable cashmere wrap (a shawl) are out-of-scope. 2026-10-24: 152 in stock, 72 styles staged, 39 duplicate, 29 out-of-scope, 7 no-composition, 3 not-womens, 2 fiber.

Added 2026-10-23 for Sleep and lounge. skinworldwide.com. Pima and organic cotton basics, small range. Shopify products.json at skinworldwide.com. No composition field; percentages only appear in the description prose, and most pieces say 'organic Pima cotton' with no percentage, so those are no-composition (64 of 87). Pieces described as stretch without a stated elastane share are no-composition too. Ramie PJ Set states only the tank. 2026-10-24: 87 in stock, 23 staged, 64 no-composition.

Added 2026-10-23 for Sleep and lounge. araks.com. Organic cotton and silk sleep and underwear. Skip gift cards (price 0). Shopify products.json at araks.com. Composition is on a 'Content:' line in body_html. Each colour is its own product: one card per style, other colours recorded as duplicate. Product types Collection, Lingerie on Film, Third Party Product and blank are photos, mugs, soaps and donations, out-of-scope. Most silk lingerie is 92% silk 8% elastane and fails; trims of 92/8 silk fail the piece. Refibra and Seacell are lyocell. The Silver Lurex Stripe pieces say 100% cotton but name a lurex stripe, so no-composition. Undisclosed lace, crochet and picot trims are staged with a 'fiber not stated' trim note. 2026-10-24: 506 in stock, 45 styles staged, 206 fiber, 168 duplicate colours, 82 out-of-scope, 5 no-composition.

Added 2026-10-23 for Sleep and lounge. desmondanddempsey.com. Cotton pajamas, a few Tencel pieces. UK brand: confirm the US price in USD. Shopify products.json at desmondanddempsey.com returns USD prices for a US visitor (the store converts from GBP; the product page shows the same $ price). Composition is on the product page under 'Fabric & Care', not in body_html. '402' pieces are 'Cotton Stretch 97% 3% elastane'. Each print is its own product; one card per garment type and fabric (e.g. Long Pyjama Set in Organic Cotton), other prints recorded as duplicate. Lyocell jersey pieces fail; the quilted robe has polyester filling, so it fails as padding. Cotton pointelle gives no percentage, so no-composition. Men's and kids pieces, eye masks, scrunchies, socks, slippers, slides and gift items are out. 2026-10-24: 330 in stock, 36 styles staged, 118 duplicate prints, 66 not-womens, 48 out-of-scope, 46 no-composition, 16 fiber.

Added 2026-10-23 for Sleep and lounge. lakepajamas.com. Mostly pima cotton, some modal. Shopify products.json at lakepajamas.com, USD; composition is a 'Made of/from ...' sentence in body_html. Titles are 'Style in Colour'; one card per style, other colours recorded as duplicate. Modal, bamboo and Tencel lines fail; sweaters with nylon and acrylic fail. Kids, baby, men's, bundles, blankets and gift tins are out. Piped pieces carry a 'Piping, fiber not stated' trim note. 2026-10-24: 386 in stock, 50 styles staged, 111 duplicate colours, 92 out-of-scope, 89 fiber, 37 not-womens, 7 no-composition.
Full products.json sweep, 67 staged. Skipped tencel/lyocell pieces, Unisex, Petite and Extended duplicates.

Shopify feed lacks composition for most pieces, so read the product page Fabric & Care section. Labels like Body, Rib, Lining split parts. 247 staged 2026-10-24 (kotn round). The 121 held pieces were staged 2026-10-24 in round 2026-10-24-nightly, which finished the sweep. 160 sold-out pieces are not recorded so a delta run picks up restocks. Exclude balaclavas, warmers, blankets, totes and men's.

Shopify products.json, composition in body_html. Multi-brand: vendor is the brand (Meals, Sonderhaus, Tyler McGillivary collabs). 2026-10-24: 182 apparel products, 51 staged, 74 failed the fiber rule (lots of polyester, Tencel/nylon and rayon), 27 rejected by the brand rules (22 graphic or word tees and tanks, 5 peasant tops), sold-out pieces left out of the ledger. Some bodies state the composition twice (prose plus Details), so read the last line that sums to 100.

Shopify products.json at www.fewmoda.com; composition on a 'Content:' line in body_html, often 'Fabric: ..., Lining: ...' or 'Fabric1/Fabric2/Base/EMB'. Read only the Content line (the prose repeats fibers). Each colour is its own product: stage one card per style name, record the other colours as duplicate. Vendor (Kourt, CAARA, o.p.t, Sorella, Few Moda) is the brand. 2026-10-24: 1,518 in stock, 381 styles staged, 859 failed the fiber rule, 50 no composition, 221 other colours, 7 rejected by the brand rules (3 argyle, 1 hooded sweater, 3 peasant tops).

Not Shopify; see REVIEW-LOOP.md. 2026-10-24: 140 women's styles from product-sitemap.xml and the /product/page grids, read through api2.wearpact.io. 97 staged (one card per style), 19 failed on elastane over 5% (leggings, shelf bra tanks, Fit & Flare dresses at 94/6), 19 multipacks and duplicate listings, 3 socks, 2 hoodies rejected by the brand rule. Lace on the lace underwear has no stated fiber; the trim note says so.

Product pages from sitemap_pdps.xml; see REVIEW-LOOP.md. 2026-10-24: 2,537 pages read, 406 in-stock pieces passed. 60 staged first, then the other 345 once the review page had room. The Cotton Mixed Media Puff Sleeve Top was dropped as no-composition: its URL says Tencel and its fiber tag says Modal/Rayon while the materials line says cotton. Ten pieces have lace, piping or mesh pocketing with no fiber stated; their trim note says so for review. 35 sold-out passing pieces are not in the ledger, so the next sweep finds them if they restock. One card per product in its first in-stock colour.

Added 2026-10-23 as a sift brand. prettylittlething.us, USD. No material filter, so shortlist from keyword pages (/shop/linen..., site search for linen, cotton, silk, wool, cashmere, leather, suede) and women's categories. Composition is in the product page HTML under PRODUCT DETAILS & CARE. Expect a very low pass rate: 'linen blend' pieces read 70% viscose. Affiliate program (Awin) was closed to new publishers when checked.
